description: Na₂Zn₂S₃ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_32_12 space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.01 Å. Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Zn atoms to form distorted SNa₃Zn₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SNa₂Zn₂ trigonal pyramids and edges with six equivalent SNa₃Zn₃ octahedra. In the second S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Zn atoms to form distorted corner-sharing SNa₂Zn₂ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-67°.
